description: A player completes the Time Keeper's Chronite Shard buy-back trades in the trading screen: scrolling the offer list down to the last two offers, selecting one, and shift-clicking the result. 12 Chronite Shards become 1 Emerald, then the remaining 8 become 1 Clockstone. The Time Keeper stands on a platform in the sky with no AI.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 16 0 31 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 20 200 4 28 200 12 minecraft:white_concrete
execute in minecraft:overworld run summon chronodawn:time_keeper 24.5 201 10.5 {NoAI:1b,Invulnerable:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b,Rotation:[180f,0f]}

steps.note: The Time Keeper trading screen with the offer list scrolled to the bottom: the last two offers are 12 Chronite Shard for 1 Emerald and 8 Chronite Shard for 1 Clockstone. The player holds 20 Chronite Shards.
The 12 Chronite Shard for 1 Emerald offer is selected: 12 Chronite Shards sit in the payment slot and 1 Emerald in the result slot.
The 8 Chronite Shard for 1 Clockstone offer is selected with 8 Chronite Shards in the payment slot and 1 Clockstone in the result slot. The Emerald from the first trade is in the inventory.

steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 16 0 31 15
